name: interruptThread
description: Interrupts a running thread created with `cfthread` or `threadNew`. A thread that is sleeping or waiting gets an exception; otherwise its interrupted flag is set, which it can check with `threadInterrupted()`. With no argument, interrupts the current thread, which must itself be a ColdFusion thread. Unlike `threadTerminate()`, the thread can handle the interrupt and stop cleanly.

params.name: threadName
params.description: Name of the thread to interrupt. Omit to interrupt the current thread.

coldfusion.notes: Listed by getFunctionList() in ColdFusion 2025+. No official documentation exists. Signature and behavior confirmed on CF2025.

examples.title: Interrupt a sleeping thread
examples.description: The thread's `sleep()` throws an exception, which it catches.
